notes.title: Announcement on ending of sale.
notes.notes:
We would like to extend our deep appreciation for a long patronage for "Otome Romance Jigsaws - Midnight Cinderella & Destined to Love", but we regret to inform you that we will finish selling it since last March 29, 2019.

We should be noted if you have already purchased it, you can continue to play it after the sale.

Thank you for your continuing support. We will always be at your service.
